The positive imaginary part controls exit through large circles. The assertion is for each fixed nonzero point of the closed half-plane, for every kappa>4; simultaneous quantifiers and trace interpretation remain separate.

Assumes trace existence, dilation invariance and the source geometric comparison. The proof excludes atoms by dilation, identifies the beta law, and checks the hypergeometric normalization. This does not prove the geometric input.

The small-ball estimate gives positive distance from the full trace for each fixed interior point. One fixed swallowed disk gives eventual nonempty interior almost surely. Scaling makes the probability constant in positive time, and monotonicity makes that constant one. Rational times give the all-times statement. This does not locate the disk near zero or prove Lemma 7.3.
